ACG138 v28.1 PicoRV32 register-file integration patch

Unpatched project source SHA256: 0836050971b3c6cdd28ac3b1e5719a67fb645161912bef1e472e63995ceb0622
Upstream ISC notice is unchanged. Only the following production edits apply:
1. Default PICORV32_REGS macro selects upstream custom register-file hook.
2. Appended acg138_regfile_ff contains31 independent32-bit DFF registers and
   combinational read muxes. x0 is constantzero. No architectural IRQ/QREG
   extension is used by the configured core.

Reason: actual v28 Gowin synthesized two SDPB register-file read banks. Vendor
primitive gate simulation of the closed SoC+motor graph showed an AUIPC→ADDI
RAW dependency consuming old read data: expected BSS pointer0x2298 became
0x288, and the first zeroing store addressed program memory. The32 firmware
RAM blocks and instruction data themselves matched the RTL. This patch makes
asynchronous read behavior structural, rather than relying on a RAMstyle hint.

Build scripts/project file lists need no additions. The extra module resides
in the alreadylisted vendor/picorv32.v, preserving existing test commands.
This claim must be checked against new synthesis (zero cpuregs SDPB), actual
gate-level RAW dependency traces, CPU boot/self-test, and control tests.
